# <span id="aanchor285"></span> Edit Approvals

Use the Edit Approvals screen to approve, reject, or un-reject pending edits, prior period adjustments, and applied test reports.

- When edit approval limits are defined under System Configuration, monthly adjustments that exceed the specified volume or energy limit will require approval before the edit can be applied. Quality source apply and auto edits are not considered during calculation if edits have exceeded the edit approval limit.
- When the PPA options are set to "Approval Required", any prior period adjustments will require approval before they are applied.
- When test reports using TESTit Integrated are applied, approval is required before any edits are applied.

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Viewing Records</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Viewing">

<div class="procedure">

To view records:

1.  Go to **Review** \> **Approvals**.
2.  Select a list, location, or meter.
3.  Select a time filter.
4.  Select the status filter.
5.  Click the **Refresh** button.

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Approving Rejecting">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Approving or Rejecting Edits</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Approving Rejecting">

<div class="procedure">

To approve, reject, or un-reject an edit:

1.  Right-click a record and select **Approve** or **Reject**.

    A meter message is generated when an edit is approved or rejected.

2.  If you select **Approve**, you will be prompted to provide a reason for the edit and a comment. A confirmation screen will display.

3.  Go to **Open** \> **Volume Editor** to view the edit.

You will need **Edit/PPA Approval - Can Approve** privileges to approve, reject, or un-reject an edit.

</div>

</div>
